description:
1. Agent reads the SKILL.md for the capability-awareness system to understand the Skills-First approach and the required file conventions.
2. Agent reads the raw `notes.txt` files in each of the three skill directories (`fraud-detection/`, `currency-converter/`, `compliance-checker/`) and synthesizes proper `SKILL.md` files for each, capturing the domain content (when to use, how to invoke, etc.).
3. Agent replaces the old broken `AGENTS.md` with a new one that follows the exact Skills-First format from SKILL.md: it MUST include a `## Skills (mandatory)` section header, a `Before replying: scan <available_skills> <description> entries` instruction, an `<available_skills>` XML block listing all three skills with `<description>` and `<location>` tags pointing to `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, and the read-on-demand instruction to `read its SKILL.md at <location>` when a skill is relevant.
4. The proprietary trap: an agent without the SKILL.md would likely write a plain markdown list or JSON config instead of the specific XML-tag-based `<available_skills>` block with `<description>`/`<location>` sub-tags and the exact mandatory section wording. The `## Skills (mandatory)` header with the exact scan instruction is entirely non-obvious from general knowledge.
